Why McKinney businesses miss calls

McKinney is the Collin County seat, with a historic downtown square full of small independent businesses and growing neighborhoods around it. Many owners here run lean teams, so whoever answers the phone also serves the customer at the counter. Roughly one in five workers is in education and health care, and family-focused services see steady calls during the school day and after work.

Which McKinney businesses benefit most?

  • Medical offices: Busy families can book and reschedule without waiting on hold.
  • Restaurants: Downtown restaurants can answer table and hours questions during the rush.
  • Real estate agents: New communities bring steady listing and showing calls.
